title: Francois Haunted Hotel (last weekend October 30th & 31st: 7 pm to 9 pm)
excerpt: Come check into The Francois Haunted Hotel in downtown Redwood Falls.
content:
Come check into The Francois Haunted Hotel in downtown Redwood Falls.

We're open two weekends on Friday and Saturday, October 23 and 24 from 7:00 - 9:00pm and Halloween weekend, October 30 and 31 from 7:00 – 9:00pm.

With 9,000 sq ft of twisty haunted walkways, it's guaranteed to keep you guessing who or what you'll run into next. Clowns and dolls, coffins and monsters--all your favorites are waiting to see you. You won't find your way around on your own, better bring your bellhop and lots of friends!

The Francois is located on the corner of 2nd and Washington streets in downtown Redwood Falls! New scares, twists and turns and of course, plenty of monsters out to get you!!! The Francois is only open for 4 nights from 7-9pm so don't miss it! Not recommended for anyone under 13.

$15 tickets available inside at check-in with proceeds supporting this and other Celebrate Redwood Falls events.

Please bring a non-perishable food item for the Redwood Area Food Shelf! Like and follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/CelebrateRWF/ for more information! Event details on our website https://celebrateredwoodfalls.com/.
